### Chimie acide-base

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[acidBaseChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Acid–base chemistry concerns proton transfer, electron-pair interactions, acidity, and the behavior of chemical systems under relevant conditions. Its models, solution properties, transformations and analytical methods are broader than reaction-pattern classification alone.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les interactions entre acides et bases et la mesure de l’acidité.

#### Fondamentaux acide-base

Skills: 3

[acidBaseFundamentals.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/acidBaseFundamentals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Conceptual acid–base models establish what counts as an acid or base, while strength and pH describe different aspects of chemical behavior and solution conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends les modèles acide-base, l’acidité et la force des acides.

##### Modèles acide-base

[acidBaseModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/skills/acidBaseModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common Arrhenius, Brønsted–Lowry and Lewis descriptions by the chemical interactions each includes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare la façon dont les principaux modèles définissent un acide ou une base.

##### Force des acides

[acidStrength.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/skills/acidStrength.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how strongly an acid tends to donate a proton under specified conditions. A stronger acid transfers protons more readily in a comparable system; this does not mean the solution is necessarily more concentrated or more hazardous.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la force d’un acide de la concentration ou du danger de sa solution.

##### pH

[pH.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/skills/pH.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a logarithmic measure of hydrogen-ion activity and its concentration-based approximations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète le pH comme une mesure logarithmique de l’acidité d’une solution.

#### Systèmes acide-base

Skills: 4

[acidBaseSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/acidBaseSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Neutralization, indicator responses, buffer equilibria and titration exemplify how acid–base behavior is observed, controlled and measured under specific conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les acides et les bases réagissent et comment mesurer leurs effets.

##### Indicateurs acide-base

[acidBaseIndicators.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/acidBaseIndicators.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why some compounds change observable properties as solution acidity varies.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les indicateurs changent d’aspect selon l’acidité.

##### Titrage acide-base

[acidBaseTitration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/acidBaseTitration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a measured equivalence relationship to infer an unknown amount or concentration.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les mesures d’un titrage acide-base pour déterminer une quantité inconnue.

##### Solutions tampons

[bufferSolutions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/bufferSolutions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how paired acid–base species resist moderate pH changes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les mélanges tampons résistent aux variations de pH.

##### Neutralisation

[neutralization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/neutralization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain net acid–base reactions and avoid assuming every neutralization gives a final pH of seven.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi une réaction acide-base ne produit pas toujours un pH neutre.

### Atomes et périodicité

Groups: 5 · Skills: 21

[atomsAndPeriodicity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomsAndPeriodicity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The organization and electronic structure of atoms underpin elemental identity, isotopes, ions and recurring chemical behavior. This domain describes atomic constituents and trends; bond formation is treated separately.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les particules à l'intérieur des atomes et les régularités qui relient les éléments chimiques.

#### Structure atomique

Skills: 4

[atomicStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/atomicStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical element identity is determined by proton number; other atomic characteristics vary independently.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce qui définit un élément et pourquoi les atomes d'un même élément peuvent différer.

##### Masse atomique

[atomicMass.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/atomicMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret atomic mass and relative atomic mass, including why a tabulated average may not be a whole number.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi la masse atomique moyenne n'est pas toujours un nombre entier.

##### Électrons et charge électrique

[electronsAndCharge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/electronsAndCharge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate electron gain or loss to ionic charge while preserving an element's identity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment la charge d'un atome change quand il perd ou gagne des électrons.

##### Neutrons et isotopes

[neutronsAndIsotopes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/neutronsAndIsotopes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate neutron count to isotopic identity without treating isotopes as different elements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi les isotopes d'un même élément n'ont pas le même nombre de neutrons.

##### Protons et numéro atomique

[protonsAndAtomicNumber.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/protonsAndAtomicNumber.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use proton count to establish elemental identity and locate an element in the periodic table.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Identifie un élément grâce à son nombre de protons.

#### Structure électronique

Skills: 5

[electronicStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/electronicStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electron occupancy and energetic organization help explain reactivity and the behavior of valence electrons.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les électrons se répartissent et pourquoi cela influence le comportement chimique.

##### Orbitales atomiques

[atomicOrbitals.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/atomicOrbitals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret orbitals as probability-based descriptions of electron states and their occupancy rather than fixed electron trajectories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends les orbitales comme des régions décrites par la probabilité de présence des électrons.

##### Configurations électroniques

[electronConfigurations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/electronConfigurations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent electron occupation for atoms and ions, respecting the applicable filling rules and exceptions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Représente la façon dont les électrons occupent les états des atomes et des ions.

##### Couches électroniques

[electronShells.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/electronShells.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use shell organization and principal energy levels to explain patterns of electron distribution without treating shells as literal paths of electrons.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les couches électroniques pour expliquer les régularités sans imaginer d'orbites planétaires fixes.

##### Formation des ions

[ionFormation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/ionFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict plausible monatomic ion charges from electron gain or loss while recognizing chemical context.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prévois les charges courantes des ions en tenant compte du milieu chimique.

##### Électrons de valence

[valenceElectrons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/valenceElectrons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use outer-electron arrangements to reason about common chemical behavior and bonding possibilities.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les électrons externes pour expliquer les ressemblances entre les réactions des éléments.

#### Chimie nucléaire

Skills: 4

[nuclearChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/nuclearChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes within atomic nuclei alter nuclide identities rather than ordinary electron bonding. The chemical emphasis is isotopic substances, decay and analytical applications; general nuclear-force physics belongs to Physics.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore en quoi les transformations des noyaux atomiques diffèrent des réactions chimiques ordinaires.

[halfLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/skills/halfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the characteristic decay time of a radioactive population without implying that individual nuclei have predictable lifetimes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends la demi-vie comme une régularité portant sur de nombreux atomes radioactifs, non comme une horloge pour un seul atome.

##### Traceurs isotopiques

[isotopeTracers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/skills/isotopeTracers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how detectable isotopic signatures can trace material pathways or provide chemical analytical evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les isotopes permettent de suivre des substances au cours de processus chimiques.

##### Transmutation nucléaire

[nuclearTransmutation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/skills/nuclearTransmutation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Account for changes in proton and nucleon number across nuclear reactions and decays.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Suis les changements du nombre de protons et de nucléons lors des transformations nucléaires.

##### Désintégration radioactive

[radioactiveDecay.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/skills/radioactiveDecay.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish spontaneous nuclear transformation from chemical reaction, including emissions and daughter nuclides.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les transformations radioactives qui changent un nucléide en un autre.

[periodicOrganization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicOrganization/periodicOrganization.data.ts)

[elementFamilies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicOrganization/skills/elementFamilies.data.ts)

[metalsNonmetalsAndMetalloids.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicOrganization/skills/metalsNonmetalsAndMetalloids.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the broad distinctions and their limitations to infer plausible chemical and physical behavior.

[periodicTableStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicOrganization/skills/periodicTableStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periods, groups and element symbols as an organized classification rather than a list ordered by bulk mass.

[periodicity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicOrganization/skills/periodicity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why some element properties recur as atomic number increases.

Skills: 4

[periodicTrends.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicTrends/periodicTrends.data.ts)

[atomicRadiusTrends.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicTrends/skills/atomicRadiusTrends.data.ts)

[electronAffinity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicTrends/skills/electronAffinity.data.ts)

[electronegativity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/periodicTrends/skills/electronegativity.data.ts)

### Liaisons et structure

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[bondingAndStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/bondingAndStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical properties arise partly from how atoms and ions are connected and how neighboring particles interact. This domain distinguishes intraparticle bonds from interactions between particles and from bulk structural arrangements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les liaisons chimiques et les attractions entre particules influencent les propriétés des matériaux.

#### Liaisons chimiques

Skills: 4

[chemicalBonds.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/chemicalBonds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different electron distributions support different limiting models of chemical bonding; real substances can have mixed characteristics.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment atomes et ions forment des liaisons avec différents arrangements électroniques.

[bondPolarity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/skills/bondPolarity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use electronegativity differences to characterize unequal electron sharing without equating every polar bond with a polar molecule.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les électrons peuvent être partagés de façon inégale dans une liaison.

[covalentBonding.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/skills/covalentBonding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain electron sharing in bonds between atoms, including differences between single and multiple bonds.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les atomes partagent les électrons dans les liaisons covalentes simples et multiples.

##### Liaison ionique

[ionicBonding.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/skills/ionicBonding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain electrostatic attraction in extended ionic structures after electron transfer is represented conceptually.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment des charges opposées maintiennent les ions ensemble dans les structures ioniques.

##### Liaison métallique

[metallicBonding.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/skills/metallicBonding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate delocalized electrons and ordered metal atoms to common metallic properties.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie les électrons mobiles des métaux à leurs propriétés caractéristiques.

Skills: 4

[interparticleInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/interparticleInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Attractions between distinct particles influence phase behavior, solubility and material properties without changing covalent connectivity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les particules s'attirent sans former de nouvelles liaisons chimiques.

[dipoleInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/skills/dipoleInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate permanent molecular polarity to orientation-dependent attractions between molecules.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les molécules polaires s'attirent selon leur orientation.

[dispersionForces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/skills/dispersionForces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain attractions arising from fluctuating electron distributions and their broad dependence on particle polarizability.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les faibles attractions causées par les changements constants de répartition des électrons.

[hydrogenBonding.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/skills/hydrogenBonding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the conditions for stronger directional interactions involving hydrogen bound to suitable electronegative atoms.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les structures moléculaires capables de former des liaisons hydrogène.

[structurePropertyRelationships.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/skills/structurePropertyRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use bonding and intermolecular interactions jointly to explain contrasting boiling points, hardness or conductivity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique les différences entre matériaux grâce aux liaisons et aux interactions entre particules.

[molecularAndExtendedStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/molecularAndExtendedStructure/molecularAndExtendedStructure.data.ts)

### Démarche d’investigation en chimie

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[chemicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/chemicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical knowledge connects observations of substances with explanations, testable models and reliable evidence. This domain covers chemistry-specific investigation and communication; general research methodology remains a cross-disciplinary concern.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les chimistes étudient les substances, testent des explications et utilisent des preuves fiables.

#### Chimie analytique

Skills: 6

[analyticalChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/analyticalChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analytical chemistry identifies particular components in samples and determines their amounts. Sample treatment, chemical selectivity and calibration govern whether signals justify a conclusion; general observation and bulk property comparison are distinct competencies.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les chimistes identifient des substances et mesurent leurs quantités dans des échantillons.

##### Interférences analytiques

[analyticalInterferences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/skills/analyticalInterferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when other sample components alter a chemical signal or selective response and determine whether a method can distinguish the target analyte.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand d’autres substances faussent une mesure analytique.

##### Courbes d’étalonnage

[calibrationCurves.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/skills/calibrationCurves.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate an instrument signal to known standards while recognizing background response, limited range and uncertainty.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Lis une courbe d’étalonnage pour relier le signal d’un instrument à des concentrations connues.

##### Identification qualitative d’un analyte

[qualitativeAnalyteIdentification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/skills/qualitativeAnalyteIdentification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use selective reactions or instrumental signatures to identify a target chemical species in a sample, recognizing that shared responses may prevent a unique identification.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise des tests chimiques ou des signaux instrumentaux pour identifier une substance dans un mélange.

##### Dosage quantitatif d’un analyte

[quantitativeAnalyteDetermination.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/skills/quantitativeAnalyteDetermination.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer the amount or concentration of a specified analyte from a justified measured signal and calculation, accounting for relevant dilution or recovery factors.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine la quantité d’une substance cible à partir de mesures adaptées.

##### Préparation d’échantillons pour analyse

[samplePreparationForAnalysis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/skills/samplePreparationForAnalysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose sample treatment, such as dissolution, extraction or dilution, to make a specified analyte measurable while considering contamination and analyte loss.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Choisis des méthodes de préparation d’un échantillon en évitant la contamination et les pertes.

##### Indices spectroscopiques

[spectroscopicEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/skills/spectroscopicEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret absorption, emission or related spectral patterns as information about chemical species, structure or concentration.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les spectres renseignent sur l’identité, la structure ou la quantité d’une substance.

[chemicalHandlingDecisions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/chemicalHandlingDecisions.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Choisis des principes de manipulation sûre à partir des informations chimiques et des conditions.

[chemicalHazardSymbols.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/chemicalHazardSymbols.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate whether observations justify a claim about composition or reaction, including alternative explanations.

##### Variables expérimentales

[experimentalVariables.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/experimentalVariables.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the manipulated chemical condition, observed response and controlled conditions in an investigation.

#### Mesures et preuves

Skills: 5

[measurementsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/measurementsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical conclusions depend on measured quantities, recorded conditions and the distinction between observed patterns and explanatory claims.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les mesures et les observations rigoureuses soutiennent les explications chimiques.

##### Interprétation des données chimiques

[chemicalDataInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/chemicalDataInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use tables and graphs to relate changing composition, time, temperature or measured property to chemical behavior.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les données chimiques pour explorer les liens entre conditions et résultats.

##### Incertitude de mesure

[measurementUncertainty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/measurementUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the precision and uncertainty of experimental measurements rather than treating every reported digit as exact.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi les valeurs mesurées comportent une incertitude plutôt qu’une précision parfaite.

##### Mesure de la masse

[measuringMass.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/measuringMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine and interpret the mass of a sample, including appropriate units and the effects of container mass.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Mesure la masse d’un échantillon en tenant compte du récipient et des unités.

##### Mesure du volume

[measuringVolume.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/measuringVolume.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine liquid or gas volume with suitable measurement conventions and acknowledge instrument limitations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Mesure le volume des liquides ou des gaz et reconnais les limites des instruments.

##### Observation des propriétés chimiques

[observingChemicalProperties.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/observingChemicalProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Record color, phase, odor when safely available from existing observations, and other relevant features without turning an inference into a measurement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Note les propriétés observables sans les confondre avec des causes déduites.

#### Questions et modèles

Skills: 4

[questionsAndModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/questionsAndModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical claims can be examined by specifying substances, observable properties, conditions and possible particle-level explanations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à formuler et expliquer des questions de chimie à l’aide de preuves et de modèles.

##### Modèles chimiques

[chemicalModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/chemicalModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use and critique diagrams, formulas and physical or computational representations according to what they show and omit.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise des schémas et des formules chimiques tout en reconnaissant leurs limites.

##### La chimie en tant que discipline

[chemistryAsADiscipline.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/chemistryAsADiscipline.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish questions about composition, properties and transformations of matter from neighboring questions about motion, organisms or technological design.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre à quelles questions la chimie peut répondre sur la matière et ses transformations.

##### Explications macroscopiques et particulaires

[macroscopicAndParticleExplanations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/macroscopicAndParticleExplanations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate an observable change, such as dissolving or gas formation, to a possible account of particles without confusing the model with direct observation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie les changements chimiques visibles à des explications possibles à l’échelle des particules.

##### Prédictions chimiques vérifiables

[testableChemicalPredictions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/testableChemicalPredictions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a predicted chemical outcome and the evidence that could support or contradict it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Formule une prédiction vérifiable sur une transformation chimique et identifie les preuves qui pourraient l’étayer.

### Langage et quantités chimiques

Groups: 3 · Skills: 18

[chemicalLanguageAndQuantities.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemists represent composition and transformation with conventional symbols and use amounts to connect microscopic entities to measurable samples. This domain covers representational and quantitative relationships, not specific reaction mechanisms.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends les symboles, formules et calculs utilisés pour décrire les substances et réactions.

#### Quantité de matière

Skills: 6

[amountOfSubstance.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/amountOfSubstance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The mole and associated quantities link atom-scale counting to bulk mass, volume and reaction proportions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie le nombre de particules aux masses mesurables et aux quantités des réactions.

##### Réactifs limitants

[limitingReactants.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/limitingReactants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine which available reactant sets the theoretical upper bound on product formation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine quel réactif limite la quantité maximale de produit possible.

##### Conversion masse–mole

[massMoleConversion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/massMoleConversion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convert between measured mass and amount of substance for a specified chemical entity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Convertis la masse d’une substance en quantité de matière en moles, et inversement.

##### Masse molaire

[molarMass.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/molarMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect formula composition to mass per mole using atomic masses.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise la masse molaire pour relier une formule à la masse d’une mole.

##### Rendement d’une réaction

[reactionYield.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/reactionYield.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish theoretical yield, observed yield and percentage yield without attributing every shortfall to one cause.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les rendements théorique et réel, puis explique le rendement en pourcentage.

##### Rapports stœchiométriques

[stoichiometricRatios.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/stoichiometricRatios.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use balanced coefficients to relate amounts of reactants and products.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise une équation équilibrée pour comparer les quantités de réactifs et de produits.

##### La mole

[theMole.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/theMole.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret amount of substance as a count-based quantity defined through Avogadro's constant.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends qu’une mole correspond à un nombre défini d’entités chimiques.

#### Notation chimique

Skills: 8

[chemicalNotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/chemicalNotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Symbols and formulas must preserve elemental identity, proportions and charge while being read according to their convention.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les symboles et formules expriment composition et charge.

##### Formules chimiques

[chemicalFormulas.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/chemicalFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Read subscripts as composition information rather than reaction coefficients.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les indices indiquent les proportions des différents atomes.

##### Symboles des éléments

[elementSymbols.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/elementSymbols.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret standard element symbols and distinguish capitalization changes that create different meanings.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Lis correctement les symboles des éléments en respectant majuscules et minuscules.

##### Formules empiriques

[empiricalFormulas.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/empiricalFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Derive or interpret the simplest whole-number elemental ratio without assuming that it specifies one molecule.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète le rapport entier le plus simple entre les éléments d’une substance.

##### Nomenclature inorganique

[inorganicNomenclature.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/inorganicNomenclature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply systematic naming conventions to inorganic compounds, considering ionic or covalent composition and oxidation states where relevant.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Applique les règles de nomenclature pour identifier les composés inorganiques.

##### Formules des composés ioniques

[ionicCompoundFormulas.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/ionicCompoundFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use ion charges to derive electrically neutral formula units.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les charges ioniques pour écrire des formules de composés électriquement neutres.

##### Formules moléculaires

[molecularFormulas.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/molecularFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret how many atoms of each element are present in a specified discrete molecule.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Lis une formule moléculaire pour identifier les atomes d’une molécule.

##### Nomenclature organique

[organicNomenclature.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/organicNomenclature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use parent structures, locants and functional groups to relate organic compound names to their molecular connectivity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie les noms systématiques des composés organiques à leur structure moléculaire.

##### États d’oxydation

[oxidationStates.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/oxidationStates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assign formal oxidation numbers under established conventions without mistaking them for measured atomic charges.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Emploie les nombres d’oxydation formels sans les confondre avec des charges réelles.

#### Équations de réaction

Skills: 4

[reactionEquations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/reactionEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An equation records reactants, products and stoichiometric relationships but is not, by itself, a mechanism.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les équations décrivent les transformations chimiques et leurs proportions.

##### Équilibrage des équations

[balancingEquations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/balancingEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose coefficients that conserve the number of each element without altering chemical formulas.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Équilibre une équation chimique sans modifier les formules.

##### Symboles d’état dans les équations

[equationStateSymbols.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/equationStateSymbols.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret notation for solid, liquid, gas and aqueous species as information about conditions or phases.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Lis les symboles indiquant solide, liquide, gaz ou espèce dissoute.

##### Équations symboliques

[symbolicEquations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/symbolicEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Translate a chemical transformation into formulas with correct reactant and product identities.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Écris les formules chimiques correctes des réactifs et des produits.

##### Équations en mots

[wordEquations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/wordEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent a described change by naming initial and resulting substances.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Décris une réaction en nommant les réactifs de départ et les produits.

### Réactions chimiques

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[chemicalReactions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/chemicalReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain identifies and explains transformations in which constituent atoms are rearranged or electron/proton transfer occurs. Chemical equation notation and amount calculations remain in their dedicated domain.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les réactions transforment les substances en réorganisant des atomes et en transférant des particules.

#### Oxydation et réduction

Skills: 5

[oxidationAndReduction.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/oxidationAndReduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electron bookkeeping describes an important class of reactions even when electrons are not explicitly transferred between discrete ions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore le lien entre oxydation, réduction et changements d’électrons.

##### Électrolyse

[electrolysis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/electrolysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how externally supplied electrical energy drives non-spontaneous redox reactions at electrodes, including transformations such as electroplating.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment l’électricité entraîne des réactions non spontanées.

##### Piles galvaniques

[galvanicCells.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/galvanicCells.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spontaneous, spatially separated oxidation and reduction reactions deliver electrical work through an external circuit while charge also flows through the electrolyte.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des réactions rédox séparées peuvent produire de l’électricité.

##### Oxydation

[oxidation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/oxidation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify increases in formal oxidation state or electron loss in appropriate reaction descriptions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Identifie l’oxydation par perte d’électrons ou hausse du nombre d’oxydation.

##### Couples rédox

[redoxCouples.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/redoxCouples.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate oxidation of one participant to reduction of another and identify oxidizing or reducing agents.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment une espèce s’oxyde pendant qu’une autre se réduit.

##### Réduction

[reduction.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/reduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify decreases in formal oxidation state or electron gain in appropriate reaction descriptions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Identifie la réduction par gain d’électrons ou baisse du nombre d’oxydation.

#### Types de réactions

Skills: 6

[reactionPatterns.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/reactionPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reaction patterns classify transformations such as combination, decomposition, precipitation, displacement, combustion and hydrolysis. Some categories may overlap and do not by themselves determine a detailed reaction mechanism.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre les façons courantes de classer les réactions chimiques.

##### Combustion

[combustion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/combustion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Characterize reactions with an oxidant that release energy, distinguishing combustion from mere heating.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends la combustion comme une réaction qui libère de l’énergie en présence d’un oxydant.

##### Réactions de décomposition

[decompositionReactions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/decompositionReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize processes in which one chemical species gives rise to multiple products.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand une substance se décompose en plusieurs produits.

##### Réactions de déplacement

[displacementReactions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/displacementReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reason about when one element can replace another in a compound.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore quand un élément peut en remplacer un autre dans un composé.

##### Hydrolyse

[hydrolysis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/hydrolysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize reactions in which water participates in bond cleavage or chemical conversion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les réactions où l’eau participe à la rupture ou à la transformation de liaisons.

##### Réactions de précipitation

[precipitationReactions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/precipitationReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the formation of an insoluble product from reacting dissolved species.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi des substances dissoutes peuvent former un solide insoluble.

##### Réactions de synthèse

[synthesisReactions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/synthesisReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize processes producing a new compound from simpler starting substances.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand des substances plus simples se combinent pour former un nouveau composé.

#### Reconnaître les réactions

Skills: 2

[recognizingReactions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/recognizingReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognizing chemical change requires identifying initial and resulting chemical species and examining observations critically rather than treating any visible sign as proof.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends comment des observations peuvent étayer l’existence d’une réaction.

##### Réactifs et produits

[reactantsAndProducts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/skills/reactantsAndProducts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify starting and resulting chemical species while distinguishing them from catalysts and solvents.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les réactifs de départ et les produits des catalyseurs ou solvants.

##### Indices de réaction

[reactionEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/skills/reactionEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret gas evolution, precipitates, color changes or thermal effects as possible evidence, with appropriate alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue si bulles, couleurs ou changements de température indiquent une réaction chimique.

### La chimie dans le monde

Groups: 4 · Skills: 20

[chemistryInTheWorld.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/chemistryInTheWorld.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical concepts support understanding of manufactured materials, environmental systems and molecules associated with life. The emphasis is composition, transformation and evidence—not industrial process engineering, clinical advice or organism-level biology.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la chimie explique les matériaux du quotidien, l'environnement et les molécules du vivant.

#### Air et eau

Skills: 5

[airAndWater.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/airAndWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Environmental samples contain reacting or partitioning chemical species whose measurements require attention to concentration and chemical form.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Étudie la chimie de l'air et de l'eau, notamment les polluants et les substances dissoutes.

##### Transformations chimiques de l'atmosphère

[atmosphericChemicalChanges.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/atmosphericChemicalChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate pollutant reactions and transformations to phenomena such as acid deposition or photochemical smog.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie les réactions chimiques atmosphériques au smog et aux dépôts acides.

##### Chimie du carbone dans l'environnement

[carbonChemistryInTheEnvironment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/carbonChemistryInTheEnvironment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Track carbon among carbon dioxide, dissolved carbonate species and organic matter without conflating chemistry with whole-ecosystem modeling.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Suis le carbone dans le dioxyde de carbone, les composés dissous et la matière organique.

##### Composition de l'air

[compositionOfAir.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/compositionOfAir.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish major atmospheric components from variable traces and pollutants.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les principaux gaz de l'air et distingue-les des polluants présents à l'état de traces.

##### L'eau comme solvant

[waterAsASolvent.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/waterAsASolvent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain polarity and hydrogen bonding behind water's distinctive solvent behavior.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi les interactions moléculaires permettent à l'eau de dissoudre de nombreuses substances.

##### Polluants de l'eau

[waterContaminants.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/waterContaminants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify dissolved and particulate contaminants by chemical identity and behavior without assuming visible clarity proves safety.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais différents polluants de l'eau sans supposer qu'une eau limpide est sans danger.

#### Chimie des matériaux

Skills: 7

[materialsChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/materialsChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A product's useful behavior depends on composition, microscopic structure and conditions of use, not merely its everyday material label.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment la structure chimique détermine certaines propriétés utiles des matériaux.

##### Alliages en pratique

[alloysInUse.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/alloysInUse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how composition and phase structure can change mechanical or corrosion properties relative to constituent metals.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les alliages peuvent avoir des propriétés différentes des métaux qui les composent.

##### Céramiques

[ceramics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/ceramics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate inorganic nonmetallic ceramic composition, microstructure and processing to characteristic mechanical and thermal behavior, recognizing that some ceramics contain glassy phases.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment la composition et la structure des céramiques influencent leur résistance mécanique et thermique.

##### Corrosion

[corrosion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/corrosion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain electrochemical deterioration and the chemical basis of common protective principles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment les réactions électrochimiques causent la corrosion et comment agit la protection.

##### Élastomères

[elastomers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/elastomers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain recoverable deformation in rubberlike polymer networks through chain mobility and cross-linking, without treating all elastic substances as identical plastics.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi certains réseaux polymères réticulés s'étirent et reprennent leur forme.

##### Verre

[glass.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/glass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the amorphous structure and glass-transition behavior of glass-forming materials, distinguishing them from ordinary crystalline solids.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi le verre se comporte différemment des solides cristallins.

##### Métaux au quotidien

[metalsInUse.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/metalsInUse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate elemental metallic structure and processing to characteristic conductivity, deformation and corrosion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie la structure et le traitement des métaux à leurs propriétés courantes.

##### Plastiques

[plastics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/skills/plastics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate polymer chemistry and processing to the shaping, durability and temperature-dependent behavior of plastic materials.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les polymères et leur mise en forme influencent les propriétés des plastiques.

#### Molécules du vivant

Skills: 4

[moleculesOfLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/moleculesOfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical structure explains molecular behavior that biology may later place in cellular or organismal context.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les structures moléculaires de substances biologiques importantes.

##### Chimie des glucides

[carbohydrateChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/skills/carbohydrateChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sugar units, glycosidic connections and chemical properties in small and polymeric carbohydrates.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment les sucres se lient pour former différents glucides.

##### Chimie des lipides

[lipidChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/skills/lipidChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize characteristic structures and intermolecular behavior of fats, oils and other lipid families.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les structures et le comportement chimique des graisses, des huiles et d'autres lipides.

##### Chimie des acides nucléiques

[nucleicAcidChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/skills/nucleicAcidChemistry.data.ts)

### Énergie, vitesses de réaction et équilibre chimique

Groups: 3 · Skills: 19

[energyRatesAndEquilibrium.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/energyRatesAndEquilibrium.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical systems exchange energy, evolve at finite rates and may approach dynamic equilibrium. These are related but distinct questions: whether change is favorable, how quickly it occurs and what composition persists.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les variations d’énergie, les vitesses de réaction et l’équilibre entre les réactions directe et inverse.

#### Énergétique chimique

Skills: 8

[chemicalEnergetics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/chemicalEnergetics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy changes are properties of a system and its processes, not intrinsic fuel labels or a claim that breaking bonds alone releases energy.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l’énergie est absorbée, libérée ou redistribuée pendant les transformations chimiques.

[bondEnergyEstimates.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/bondEnergyEstimates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Approximate enthalpy changes from bonds broken and formed while recognizing average bond-energy limitations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Estime l’énergie de réaction à partir des liaisons rompues et formées, en connaissant les limites du modèle.

[calorimetry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/calorimetry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer heat transfer from measured temperature change, heat capacity and appropriate system boundaries, recognizing energy losses and measurement uncertainty.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Estime les transferts de chaleur à partir des variations de température, en tenant compte des pertes.

[endothermicProcesses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/endothermicProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret positive system enthalpy change and recognize that absorbing heat need not mean a reaction cannot occur.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les processus qui absorbent de la chaleur sans supposer qu’ils sont impossibles.

##### Entropie

[entropy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/entropy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the multiplicity of microscopic arrangements and energy dispersal to changes in thermodynamic entropy.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les liens entre dispersion de l’énergie, arrangements des particules et entropie.

##### Processus exothermiques

[exothermicProcesses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/exothermicProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret negative system enthalpy change under stated conditions and distinguish released heat from reaction rate.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les processus qui libèrent de la chaleur sans supposer qu’ils sont rapides.

[gibbsEnergy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/gibbsEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate enthalpy, temperature and entropy to the direction of spontaneous change at constant temperature and pressure.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise l’énergie de Gibbs pour juger si une transformation est favorisée dans certaines conditions.

##### Loi de Hess

[hesssLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/hesssLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine known reaction equations and associated enthalpy changes to determine an overall enthalpy change using the state-function character of enthalpy.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Combine des variations énergétiques connues pour calculer l’enthalpie d’une autre réaction.

##### Enthalpie de réaction

[reactionEnthalpy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/skills/reactionEnthalpy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate heat at constant pressure to the difference in enthalpy between states.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare l’énergie avant et après une réaction à l’aide de la variation d’enthalpie.
